Our Story

Born from a simple idea — travel should feel easy at every age.

Lakbayan began with one observation: many elderly Filipinos want to see and explore the country, but most tours move too fast or simply aren't built for their needs. So we created a travel agency with a single focus — safe, relaxing, and well-planned trips for senior travelers.

We help senior citizens experience travel without the stress. Comfortable transportation, proper accommodations, and activities matched to their interests and capabilities. The goal is simple: meaningful memories, and a journey where every guest feels genuinely cared for and valued.

Mission & Vision

What we're traveling toward.

01 Our Mission

Meaningful journeys for every elder.

To create meaningful and amazing journeys for elderly travelers by providing safe, comfortable, affordable, and unforgettable travel experiences with their loved ones, friends, and families.

02 Our Vision

The most trusted name in senior travel.

To become one of the most trusted and leading travel agencies, recognized for exceptional, memorable experiences for the elderly — delivering accessibility, comfort, enjoyment, and affordability for everyone while promoting local culture in every destination.
